text: روحنا الساعة ١م تقريبا و الوايتر خد وقت عشان يظهر و ياخد الاوردر. طلبنا فطار انا و صحابي ، هما طلبوا american breakfast beef bacon و انا طلبت smoked beef breakfast. الاكل اتأخر اوي و لما نزل طلع الاوردر مش مظبوط و بالاخص الطبق بتاعي. المفروض ان البطاطس تبقي hash brown و جتلي بطاطس محمرة عادية، البيف المشوي بقي شرايح سموكد بيف من اي سوبرماركت ، المفروض يبقي فيه خس كابوتشا iceberg و مجاش (و لما سألت الويتر فين الخس اللي المفروض ينزل مع الطبق، قالي شكل الطبق اللي نزل ده هو الصح ، و راح جابلي طبق صغير فيه شرايح خيار و طماطم و زيتون اسود)، محطوط ٣ مشرومات صغيرين جدا، و اخيرا ليس اخرا البيض انا طلباه بينيدكت benedict (هما كاتبين في المنيو اننا نختار اي نوع بيض عايزينه بدل الاومليت) و جالي شكله اومليت (مرفق صورة لوصف الطبق في المنيو و صورة للفطار اللي جالي علي الواقع). ف طبعا ناديت الوايتر و قولتلوا ان الطبق مش مظبوط خالص و ان البيض ده اكيد معمول غلط ف قالي انه حاضر هيدخل للشيف يظبطهولي. الاكل اتأخر اوي و صحابي كانوا قربوا يخلصوا اكل . جابلي الطبق اخيرا و طلع زي الطبق الاول بالظبط، مع اختلاف ان البيض بدل ما هو اومليت متطبق ٤ اربع بقي جايلي قطعة واحدة شبه البان كيك. قولتلوا يا عم ده مش بينيدكت خالص! .. قالي تحبي الغي الاوردر قولتله لا خلاص انا جعانة و صحابي بيخلصوا اكلهم. لما جينا نحاسب ظهر لنا المدير عشان ندفع بالفيزا ف اشتكيت و حكيتله اللي حصل, قالي معلش انا اسف بس المنيو اتعدلت و احنا لسه مغيرناش الqr code بتاع المنيو اللي علي الترابيزات ف حقك عليا. قولتله المفروض ان تقول للوايتر ان لما حد يطلب الطبق ده تنبهه ان الطبق اتغير خالص . و انتهي الكلام علي كده. المكان نفسه مش وحش لكن مش عارفة هاروحلهم تاني ولا لا بعد المقلب ده.
textTranslated: We arrived around 1 PM, and the waiter took a while to appear and take our order. My friends and I ordered breakfast; they ordered American breakfast beef bacon, and I ordered smoked beef breakfast. The food was very late, and when it finally arrived, the order was completely wrong, especially my dish. The potatoes were supposed to be hash brown, but I received regular French fries. The grilled beef turned out to be smoked beef slices from any supermarket. There was supposed to be iceberg lettuce, but it wasn't there (and when I asked the waiter where the lettuce was, he said that what the dish that arrived looked like was the correct one, and then he brought me a small plate with sliced ​​cucumber, tomato, and black olives). There were three very small mushrooms, and last but not least, the eggs—I ordered a Benedict (they said on the menu that we could choose any type of egg we wanted instead of an omelet)—looked like an omelet (I've attached a picture of the dish description on the menu and a picture of the actual breakfast I received). So, of course, I called the waiter and told him the dish was completely off and that the eggs were definitely made wrong. He said he'd go check with the chef and fix it. The food was taking forever, and my friends were almost finished eating. He finally brought the dish, and it was exactly the same as the first one, except the eggs, instead of being a four-layered omelet, were now one piece that looked like a pancake. I told him, "This isn't Benedict at all!" He asked if I wanted to cancel the order, and I said no, I was starving, and my friends were finishing their food. When we went to pay, the manager came out to ask us to pay by card, so I complained and told him what happened. He said, "Sorry, but the menu has been updated, and we haven't changed the QR codes on the tables yet, so it's my fault." I told him he should tell the waiter to let the customer know the menu has been completely changed. And that was the end of the conversation. The place itself isn't bad, but I don't know if I'll go back to them again or not after this prank.

text:
【烤牛肉面】
杭州人，淡口，写给国人：
面是老家做拌面的那种面条，冲着这点来的。面条本身口感可以的。
亚洲风味是比较融合的那种，里面有日本洋葱丝，韩国辣白菜，加上算是中国的面条，就很……emmmm
口味很咸，店家很大方应该放了很多酱油和盐吧，以杭州人的口味我觉得可以要求他们减少到1/3……因为太咸了一边吃一边喝水马上就饱了。
以我平常的实力不至于吃不完一碗的哎。
textTranslated:
[Roasted Beef Noodles] A Hangzhou native, with a light palate, writing for fellow countrymen: The noodles are the kind used for mixed noodles back home, which is why I came here. The noodles themselves are quite tasty.

The Asian flavor is a fusion, with Japanese onion slices, Korean kimchi, and what's basically Chinese noodles, so it's...emmmm... The flavor is very salty. The restaurant is very generous; they probably added a lot of soy sauce and salt. For someone from Hangzhou, I think they should ask them to reduce it to about 1/3... because it was so salty that I got full very quickly while drinking water.

Normally, I wouldn't have been unable to finish a bowl.

name: Ibrahim Abdellatif
text:
I came in with an old friend looking for a place to sit, catch up, and grab drinks. While browsing the menu, we were considering a few food options, but when we started by ordering just drinks, the manager immediately stopped us—refusing to serve us unless we ordered food. He claimed "they are a restaurant, not a cafe" and were afraid people would sit for hours with laptops.

Since we were busy catching up and didn't want the hassle of leaving to find another spot, we gave in and ordered dessert with our drinks just to stay. Sadly, both the drinks and desserts were mediocre at best.

The logic here is completely absurd. The place was almost empty when we arrived, and completely empty by the time we left. I even tried to give the manager polite, constructive feedback—warning him that enforcing rigid rules out of fear of hypothetical laptop campers was hurting his own business more than anything—but he just kept stubbornly insisting on his policy.

Great restaurants focus on welcoming guests and building goodwill, not treating paying customers with pre-baked mistrust. Unbelievably poor business logic. Save your time and go somewhere that actually understands hospitality.

text:

The place was clean, and I personally liked how quiet the indoor area was — it made the experience feel calm and relaxed.
While the service was average and the dine-in experience didn’t particularly stand out, the quality of the food itself makes it worth trying. I think I might go for the takeaway option next time, as it could suit the overall vibe even better.
Overall, a solid 3.5/5 experience with good, comforting koshari — and I’d definitely consider ordering again.

text:
الاكل ممتاز المشاوي عندهم ممتازة و يمكن احسن مكان كلت فيه حمام، الاكل جه بسرعه متاخرش و الستاف هناك بشوشين و بيهتمو جدا براحة العميل.
المحاشي مكانتش احسن حاجه بالذات المشكل لكن غير كدة كله كان ممتاز. طلبنا وجبتين حمام محشي و كفتة و شيش و بطاطس و معاهم محشي ورق عنب و محشي مشكل و ارز ابيض مع سلاطات و عيش و السعر كان ٧٤٠ جنيه شامل الخدمة و الضريبة.

اكيد هكرر التجربة تاني.
textTranslated:
The food was excellent, especially the grilled meats. It was probably the best place I've ever eaten pigeon. The food arrived quickly, and the staff were friendly and attentive to customer comfort.

The stuffed vegetables weren't the best, especially the mixed ones, but otherwise, everything was excellent. We ordered two meals: stuffed pigeon, kofta, shish kebab, potatoes, stuffed grape leaves, mixed stuffed vegetables, white rice, salads, and bread. The price was 740 Egyptian pounds, including service and tax.

I will definitely return.

Service was poor as well. Despite placing a large order for just three people, no one offered to help carry the tray to our table, so I had to make multiple trips myself.

textTranslated:
We placed an order with Talabat Tamam, and they said it would arrive in 60 minutes.
An hour and a half later, we called, and they said it was out and would arrive in 20 minutes.
Half an hour later, we called again, and they said it would arrive in 10 minutes.
Another half hour later, we called and asked if the order was coming or if the driver had eaten it. We had already paid by Visa, so they called the driver and he said the order had been delivered! We asked, "How was it delivered?" After 3 hours, the order arrived extremely cold and frozen, and the sugar pie was ruined because the sugar had melted and turned into water. We threw it away. This is the last time we'll order from you. This restaurant is extremely negligent and unreliable. Note: The restaurant is only 10 minutes away and not far from us.

text: Waren hier am ersten Abend unseres Ägyptenbesuchs und fanden deftige italienische Küche vor. Der Kellner Mohamed A Motadieb war sehr zuvorkommend und brachte uns Willkommensgetränke und eine schöne Platte mit Humus und Brot. Die Pizza war sehr schön käsig und die Bolognese auch reich an Hack und Soße. Das Ambiente ist ok. Es ist ein sehr großer hell beleuchteter Gastraum und beim öffnen der Tür zur Terrasse bläst die Klimaanlage eiskalt los. Es gab Musik in angenehmer Lautstärke.
textTranslated: We were here on the first evening of our visit to Egypt and found hearty Italian cuisine. The waiter, Mohamed A Motadieb, was very attentive and brought us welcome drinks and a nice platter of hummus and bread. The pizza was wonderfully cheesy, and the Bolognese was also generous with ground meat and sauce. The ambiance is okay. It's a very large, brightly lit dining room, and the air conditioning blasts icy cold air as soon as you open the door to the terrace. There was music playing at a pleasant volume.

name: Hala Sharaf-Eldin
text: Their chicken and mushroom dish was the best out of all the dishes we tried, but the rest of the dishes were average at best. The service wasn't lacking, and they catered to all our requests. The place isn't spotless, but not to the point of being unhygienic. The decor also added a nice touch and perfectly fit the Italian vibe. Although I wouldn't call it extraordinary, I must admit you get great value in exchange for what you pay. Amazing portions that are very filling, good service and okay food. All in all, if you are looking for a nice spot with a good pricing point and are fine with inauthentic, but passable food, I would highly recommend their chicken and mushroom dish for a great experience.

text: من أسوأ الأماكن اللي ممكن حد يتعامل معاها، ناس في منتهى الإهمال وقلة الذوق وعدم النظام. طلبت اوردر بالتليفون والشخص بلغني انه هيوصل في 45 دقيقة، الاوردر اتاخر ولاقيت الدليفري بيكلمني بعد ساعة ونص وبيقولي ابعتلي لوكيشن، بعتله لوكيشن اتصل بيا بعدها ب10 دقايق يقولي انا وصلت، فبقوله وصلت فين يقولي وصلت عندك، قلت له ابعتلي لوكيشن علشان اشوف انت فين، لاقيته في مكان تاني بعيد عني ب20 دقيقة عالاقل، طلبت منه يكنسل الاوردر واتصلت بالمطعم عملت شكوى قالولي احنا هنكلم الدليفري ونرجع نقولك الاوردر هيوصلك امتى وماتصلوش بعدها ولا اعتذروا. مانصحش بالمكان ده لانهم تعبانين وعلى الله حكايتهم جداً.
textTranslated: This is one of the worst places anyone could ever deal with. The staff are incredibly negligent, rude, and disorganized. I placed an order by phone, and the person told me it would arrive in 45 minutes. The order was delayed, and the delivery driver called me an hour and a half later asking for my location. I sent it, and he called back 10 minutes later saying he'd arrived. I asked him where, and he said he'd arrived at my place. I told him to send me his location so I could see where he was, but he was at least 20 minutes away. I asked him to cancel the order and called the restaurant to file a complaint. They told me they'd contact the delivery driver and get back to me with an estimated delivery time, but they never called back or apologized. I don't recommend this place at all; they're terrible and their service is completely unreliable.

Narges branch new Cairo
If I could give less than one star, I absolutely would.

The quality was extremely disappointing. Don’t let anyone convince you to order from Al Raai. As shown in the video, the fava beans were more like bean soup, and the falafel was completely soaked in oil.

When I called to complain, all I received was an apology—just like many other restaurants I encountered during my vacation. Unfortunately, apologies are always available, but actual solutions are nowhere to be found.

The restaurant manager politely called me, apologized, and promised to send a replacement order of fava beans. I waited for an entire hour, but nothing arrived. When I called him again, I received yet another apology.

Honestly, I am extremely disappointed and deeply dissatisfied with both the food quality and the customer service. A truly “wonderful” restaurant—with “excellent” service and quality. Absolutely disgusting! 😡😡

و رد العاملين كلهم في منتهي الاستفزاز مش عاجبك براحتك و بالفعل ٢ رجعوا الاوردر امبارح
تجربة غير مفضل تكرراها مره اخري
textTranslated: Unfortunately, the takeaway service is incredibly disorganized. I can't blame the employee handling orders when they're supposed to be delivering orders to delivery drivers along with customers who have already placed orders. The same place where dine-in food is served is also crowded with delivery drivers – it's truly infuriating. Even more infuriating is the response from every single employee, starting with the cashier, who always says, "It's not my problem, talk to the manager." And when you talk to the manager, they say management doesn't want to make any changes. The employees' responses are all incredibly dismissive: "If you don't like it, tough luck." And actually, two people returned their orders yesterday. This is an experience I wouldn't want to repeat.

الاكل اكثر من رائع و الشيف الموجود خطير و طريقة التسوية جميلة
و لكن يوجد مشكله في الادارة
المحل محتاج مدير تكون ليه الكلمه الاولي و الأخيرة
صوت العاملين عالي و نقاشهم مع بعض امام الزباين حاجه غير مفضله
نصحية برجاء حل موضوع الادارة و تدريب العاملين علي التعامل مع الزباين بشكل احترافي اكتر من كده و شكرا
و حاجه اخيرة الوقت الي انتظرنا الاكل ينزل فيه كان كتير جدا بالنسبه للمطاعم الأسماك
انتظرنا ساعه تقرييا
textTranslated: The food is more than wonderful, the chef is amazing, and the cooking is beautiful. However, there's a problem with the management. The restaurant needs a manager who has the final say. The staff are loud, and their discussions in front of customers are unpleasant. My advice is to please address the management issue and train the staff to deal with customers more professionally. Thank you. One last thing: the wait time for our food was very long for a seafood restaurant. We waited almost an hour.

المندي والبرياني عندها حكاية تانية خالص... ريحة تفتح النفس، وطعم يخلّي أول لقمة تقول "واااو". 🤤❤️
اللحمة والفراخ مستوية على أصولها، طرية جدًا، والتتبيلة ولا غلطة، والرز متشرب النكهة لآخر حباية
واللي عجبني أكتر إن الجودة ثابتة والكميات محترمة، والأسعار ممتازة جدًا مقارنة بجودة الأكل
بكل أمانة، من أحسن الأماكن اللي جربتها، وأنصح أي حد بيعشق الأكل الخليجي الأصيل يجربها. تستاهل كل الدعم، وربنا يباركلها ويزيدها نجاح. 🌹👏
textTranslated:
Seriously, if you haven't tried Madam Walaa's food at
Greesh & Qursan Restaurant in New Cairo yet... you're missing out! 😍🔥

Her mandi and biryani are on another level... the aroma is mouth-watering, and the taste makes you say "Wow!" from the very first bite. 🤤❤️ The meat and chicken are cooked perfectly, incredibly tender, the seasoning is flawless, and the rice is infused with flavor down to the last grain.
What I loved most is the consistent quality, the generous portions, and the excellent prices compared to the quality of the food.
Honestly, it's one of the best places I've tried, and I recommend it to anyone who loves authentic Gulf cuisine. She deserves all the support, and may God bless her and grant her continued success. 🌹👏

textTranslated: The worst and most disgusting place I've ever eaten at in the world. It was absolutely awful. The shawarma was literally freezing cold. I told the guy serving it that it was freezing, and he said it was cold. I told him it was freezing, and if it was cold, it would be fine. The food is supposed to be served cold. And the Kaiser rolls, I swear, they had meat all over them. Honestly, the food was garbage, not food. I ordered a Pepsi, paid for it, and they didn't put it on the receipt. name: Mohamed Hamed
text:
"جربت What The Truck وطلبت Philly Cheese Sandwich و Loaded Fries، لكن بصراحة أول مرة الجودة ما كانتش كويسة. تواصلت مع خدمة العملاء وبلغتهم بالمشكلة، وبعدها صاحب المطعم بنفسه تواصل معايا واهتم جدًا إنه يصلّح التجربة وبعتلي الأوردر تاني.
المرة التانية كانت مختلفة تمامًا، الأكل كان على أعلى مستوى فعلًا والجودة ممتازة. بصراحة يحسب لهم اهتمامهم برضا العميل وسرعة استجابتهم.
تجربة فيها غلطة في الأول، لكن طريقة التعامل خلت الانطباع   النهائي إيجابي 👍"
textTranslated: "I tried What The Truck and ordered a Philly Cheese Sandwich and Loaded Fries, but honestly, the first time the quality wasn't good. I contacted customer service and informed them of the problem, and then the owner himself contacted me and took great care to fix the experience and resent my order. The second time was completely different; the food was truly top-notch and the quality was excellent. Honestly, their attention to customer satisfaction and quick response deserve credit. The experience had a mistake at the beginning, but the way they handled it made the final impression positive 👍"

name: Ahmed Elamory
text:
I had to update my review after the amazing attitude from both the owner and the team at Kolbasti Kitchen.

My first experience honestly wasn’t great. I ordered the Kolbasti Chicken, Kolbasti Beef, and Lasagna. The chicken was okay, but it didn’t really live up to the expectations built from the branding and videos. I really didn’t enjoy the beef, and the lasagna also wasn’t for me.

What made me change my review was how the team handled everything. They actually reached out to me, listened to my feedback, and genuinely wanted a chance to make things right. They insisted I give them another try and even refused to let me pay for the replacement order.

I ended up trying the steak and pasta this time, and honestly, both were really, really good.

More than the food itself, I genuinely appreciated the way they dealt with me. You can tell they care about customer experience and take feedback seriously, and I really respect that.

Wishing them all the best and continued success inshaAllah.
address: 45 street new dahab building, New Cairo 1, Cairo Governorate 4735344, Egypt
title: The Kolbasti Lounge

I placed an order on their website and they told me it would arrive within an hour. After an hour, no one contacted me, so I messaged them and was surprised to hear from their WhatsApp service that they had no order for me. I asked how that was possible and sent them the order number and details. They said, "Okay, ma'am, it will arrive within an hour." I told them I had placed the order an hour ago, that was the delivery time. They said it would be better to order via WhatsApp instead of the website in the future, and that the order would take its normal delivery time and I would have to wait another hour.
If your website is down, why are you even keeping it open and telling people to order through it?

name: Ahmed Asaker
text: معاملة سيئة
textTranslated: Bad treatment
responseFromOwnerText:
نشكر حضراتكم على مشاركة تقييمكم.

نود توضيح أن تقييمكم لا يعكس بدقة ما حدث خلال زيارتكم. نأخذ جميع الملاحظات المتعلقة بسلامة وراحة ضيوفنا على محمل الجد، ونحرص دائمًا على توفير بيئة محترمة ومريحة للجميع.

كان التعامل المباشر مع مجموعتكم من خلال مدير المطعم فقط، حيث تم توضيح سياسة المطعم الخاصة بمنع لعب الكوتشينة والألعاب داخل المكان بكل احترام. إلا أن النقاش حول هذه السياسة تطور إلى أسلوب غير لائق في التعامل مع مدير المطعم، تضمن ألفاظًا غير مناسبة وسخرية لا تتماشى مع الاحترام المتبادل الذي نحرص عليه مع جميع ضيوفنا.

كما نود التأكيد أن باقي فريق العمل لم يكن له أي تعامل مباشر مع مجموعتكم، ولذلك نرى أنه من غير المنصف وصف الموظفين بعدم الاحترافية أو الاحترام بناءً على هذه الزيارة.

نحترم حق كل عميل في التعبير عن تجربته وتقييم الخدمة، ولكننا نؤكد أهمية أن تعكس التقييمات الوقائع الفعلية بصورة عادلة ودقيقة، ونرفض الادعاءات التي لا تعكس ما حدث بالفعل.

نظل ملتزمين بتقديم تجربة مميزة، والحفاظ على بيئة محترمة ومريحة لجميع ضيوفنا، مع تطبيق سياسة المطعم بما يضمن احترام الجميع.

So we decided to sit down, thinking that perhaps someone would come and take our order. However, we found the table dirty and covered with leftover croissant crumbs.

We waited for a while, but still no one came to take our order, so we eventually left because the atmosphere was unpleasant.

Why isn’t there a dedicated employee at the cashier to take customers’ orders? If there isn’t one, why didn’t anyone simply tell us to have a seat and that someone would come to serve us? And why was an employee shouting in a place that is supposed to be relaxing?

Overall, the atmosphere simply does not match the standard or character of the place.

name: Mohammed Almkki
text:
The worst experience you could possibly have when you’re simply trying to go out, relax, and sit somewhere that is supposed to be upscale.

We walked in normally, like any other customers, and took some time looking at the pastries and displays to decide what we wanted.

We stood there. And stood there. And stood there. Completely ignored.

The staff were walking back and forth behind the counter, yet nobody even bothered to acknowledge us or look our way. After a while, one employee finally came over, threw a plate onto the counter, and said: “انا طالعة عين امي”.

Then he started banging on the counter aggressively. There was absolutely no respect or basic courtesy, as if we weren’t even there.

I told the person I was with, “Let’s just sit down since the situation is like this.” We went to a table, only to find it dirty and covered in croissant crumbs.

We sat there for a while, and once again, nobody came to take our order. The entire atmosphere felt tense, unwelcoming, and completely unpleasant. It was the kind of atmosphere that makes you want to get up and leave rather than sit there for even a minute.

After all of that, we simply walked out.

Honestly, I cannot imagine anyone in their right mind willingly coming back after being treated this way. One of the worst cafés I’ve ever experienced when it comes to cleanliness, hospitality, and basic respect. Definitely not the upscale experience you would expect from a place like this.
